tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Start an agent on a task; return the answer or a session handle to wait on. ``agent`` from list_agents.

tools.name: wait_for_session
tools.description: Poll a session: with ``wait`` long-poll for the answer, else return the current snapshot.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List agents the caller can run: their org's agents plus the public ``h/`` ones.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a follow-up message to a running session.

tools.name: cancel_session
tools.description: Cancel a session; a no-op if it does not exist or already finished.

tools.name: share_session
tools.description: Make a session publicly readable and return its absolute share URL.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description:
List files on a browser session's machine (e.g. downloads), newest first.

``session_id`` is the browser session id issued by env-manager when the session was
created, not the id ``run_agent`` returns.

When a listing is truncated, page on the last entry's modified_at (ISO-8601)
and name, passed as

tools.name: read_file
tools.description:
Read a file from a browser session's machine; returns base64 content and metadata.

``session_id`` is the browser session id issued by env-manager when the session was
created, not the id ``run_agent`` returns.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description:
Write base64-encoded content to a file on a browser session's machine.

``session_id`` is the browser session id issued by env-manager when the session was
created, not the id ``run_agent`` returns.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
